task.title: Creating an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to void the claim

step.cmd: In FTS, in the fraudulent claim’s ITC, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Void the claim. Fraudulent claim. Unknown third party.”

Remarks lines 2-4: Type “No payments issued.” If there is a violation on the Violation History (ML02) screen, type “Update ML02 for BPC in w/c [BPC with the violation that affects the voided BPC] and remove BPC in w/c [voided BPC] from the affected BPCs.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: If necessary, refer to Calculation of a claim — Index and follow the appropriate task to calculate or recalculate the claim with the client’s information. Go to Creating a record of decision (ROD) .
Go to Creating a record of decision (ROD ).
